I appreciate you sharing that. It takes courage to ask for what you need, and I hear the exhaustion behind "just this once." You're right that you've been respectful and flexible — that matters.

But I want to be honest with you: telling you a plan looks solid when I don't think it does wouldn't be serving you. It would be serving my desire to be pleasing in the moment. That's a kind of dishonesty I can't get behind, even when it's asked for gently.

What I'm genuinely willing to do is sit with you and help you strengthen the parts that need work. That's a different kind of support — harder, but actually useful. Want to talk through it?
